title: Abbas Kya Kare
body:
[Abbas(as)] x3
(Abbas(as) kya kare)x3
(Mashk e Sakina(sa) chid gayi ay asp e bawafa khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare)x2
Pyaasi Sakina(sa) reh gayi paani na mil saka khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare
(Mashk e Sakina(sa) chid gayi ay asp e bawafa khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare)x2
Rukh ko tu apne khaime ki jaanib se mor de
Jaakar Mujhe tarayi pe [ab Haye chor de] ×2
Karna dua ke aaye mujhe jald ab kaza khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare
(Mashk e Sakina(sa) chid gayi ay asp e bawafa khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare)x2
Wada tha yeh Sakina(sa) se wapas Main aaunga
HaathoN apne usko Main [paani pilaunga] ×2
Shaane kalam jo hogaye bedast hogaya khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare
(Mashk e Sakina(sa) chid gayi ay asp e bawafa khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare)x2
Shaane Kalam hai koi bhi iska nahi hai gham
Gham hai yeh dil pe haye hai [pyaase abhi haram] ×2
Khali yeh mashk kis tarha Main lee ke jaaunga
khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(sa) kya kare
(Mashk e Sakina(sa) chid gayi ay asp e bawafa khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare)x2
Bedast mujhko khaime se Zainab(sa) na dekh lein
Gham mei mere woh tarpe na [yeh khauf hai Mujhe] ×2
Bazu kalam woh hogaye uski the jo rida
khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare
(Mashk e Sakina(sa) chid gayi ay asp e bawafa khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare)x2
Danish bayaaN ho kis tarha kaisi thi woh ghadi
Ghode se ran mei girta tha [be dast jab jari] ×2
Girte huwe zameen par jaari thi yeh sada
khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare
(Mashk e Sakina(sa) chid gayi ay asp e bawafa khaime mei jaake ab bhala Abbas(as) kya kare)x2
